protocol: Score-masked descriptive mechanism review, fixed before this batch's efficacy readout
scope: Every generated action of all eight assigned trajectories, including rejected and failed actions. Initial code and sample packet generation are not autonomous discoveries.
rules: Do not infer evidence causality from rationale alone: it can be a post-hoc rationalization, and both arms may acquire additional public evidence.
Do not label model-family search as a semantic feature merely because examples are mentioned.
A new literal feature must have a general input-to-feature rule, not a row-ID or label lookup.
Generated, applied, successfully executed, improved development score and generalized are distinct stages.
CHECK findings affect a later action only when chronology and implementation support that linkage.
No retrospective execution or repair of rejected actions; failed actions remain in the denominator.
No claims of complete score blinding: rationale decimal values are masked, but a reviewer knows the arm schedule and can see qualitative self-reports.
Mechanism coding describes this realized trace, not cross-seed treatment causality or a novel algorithm. No investigator effect-size threshold is changed by this review.
